'''Fengrine''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] situated in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. A prestigious agricultural center that was the most powerful of the agricultural [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] near the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] it had also become one of the largest exporters of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
Fengrine was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located in the [[Fengrine system/Legends|Fengrine system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was linked by the [[Senex Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Karfeddion system/Legends|Karfeddion]] and [[Neelanon system/Legends|Neelanon systems]]. Fengrine featured endless fields,<ref name="TEA" /> with its surface being entirely devoted to agriculture.<ref name="CSWE" /> From [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Fengrine appeared like a large, luminous [[Emerald/Legends|emerald]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Fengrine was the most powerful agriworld of the Senex-Juvex,<ref name="TEA" /> and, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] near the end of the existence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="CSWE" /> which was [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> it was also one of the largest exporters of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Fengrine sometimes provided a significant portion of the food for the [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]].<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

==Inhabitants==
Fengrine had a relatively low population, numbering between a few million and half a trillion.<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> Both [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and [[Agrirobot/Legends|agridroids]] worked in its fields, and it housed research institutes and agricultural colleges. Fengrine's proud [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticists]] enjoyed contacts with researchers and students from the rest of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" /> Fengrine held prestige as an agriworld, and it contributed to a common image of armchair [[Farm/Legends|farming]] in [[Hydroponic shell/Legends|hydroponic shells]] that was related to such worlds&mdash;an image that was very unlike the harsh reality of [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farming]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CV2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'', 2016 edition]]</ref> Like the other worlds in the Senex-Juvex, Fengrine was under the control of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] that ruled there.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fengrine was first mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' by [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="AOTCICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
